name: Melanotan II

protocolDosing.frequency: once daily during loading, then maintenance
protocolDosing.notes: non-selective melanocortin agonist (tanning + sexual arousal); no approved dose; melanoma/renal-infarction safety flags. t½ ~33 h

effects: Cyclic synthetic melanocortin agonist (MC1R, MC3R, MC4R) — tanning and sexual function
Stimulates melanogenesis — skin darkening without UV; persists weeks after stopping
Potent aphrodisiac via MC4R in CNS — spontaneous erections in men; libido increase in both sexes
Nausea (often severe at first dose — start low); facial flushing, fatigue, yawning
Risk of existing mole/nevi darkening or new pigmented lesions — monitor skin carefully
Elevated blood pressure; potential cardiovascular risk
Not FDA approved; unscheduled in most jurisdictions but sold illegally; sold as 'tanning peptide'
High contamination risk from unregulated suppliers — fake/underdosed products common
Sourced from research-chemical suppliers — purity and sterility not guaranteed; risk of contamination
